faqs.question: Is the BTech Mechanical Engineering syllabus the same for all colleges?
faqs.answer:
The BTech Mechanical Engineering syllabus is not the same across all colleges, as every college committee sets a particular coursework pattern at the start of every academic year to be followed for the respective batch. The syllabus includes some core subjects, interesting electives, and lab work that gives detailed knowledge to the students about the workings of the field.

faqs.question: What do Electrical Engineering professionals do?
faqs.answer:
Electrical Engineering professionals are engineering jack of all trades, as they make use of their knowledge of Physics and Mathematics along with computer programming skills to develop intricate circuit systems. These circuit boards run electrical signals to and from electrical components to accomplish everything from a mundane computer startup to controlling absolute power and precision of a rocket going out of earth's atmosphere.

faqs.answer:

placements.overview:
SSM College of Engineering is a private institute, established in 1998 in Namakkal, Tamil Nadu. SSM College of Engineering is approved by AICTE and offers a total of 20 courses at UG and PG levels in 10 specialisations such as Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Science Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Electronics & Communication Engineering. Furthermore, it offer courses such as B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, M.Sc. and MCA in Full Time mode. SSM College of Engineering fee structure includes a total tuition fee ranging from INR 35,000 to 2,00,000. SSM College of Engineering has an annual seat intake of 654 for all the programmes. It offers courses, in streams such as Engineering, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software and Science. The institute has a safe and well-equipped campus with all the advanced facilities.

At the UG and PG levels, SSM College of Engineering offers a diverse range of progammes. Candidates can choose Full Time courses, from streams like Engineering, Business & Management Studies and IT & Software. College offers B.E. / B.Tech courses at the UG level. While, at the PG level, the college offers available programmes like M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM and M.Sc. The SSM College of Engineering course fee ranges between INR 35,000 to 2,00,000.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Petroleum Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Teaching quality is not good. They provide placements for the students.

review_content.Placements: We did get many opportunities because it was pandemic. While we are passing now, they are providing some compensation for placement. They're also providing some placement training for students. The students of the entire college do not get placements from single companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: We had a playground in our hostel, and we also tried hostel facilities. Boys hostels are not very good. There is no gym or medical service in the hostel. The campus has a good library, which has all the books available for semester exams. Mess food and snacks are not good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college for students.

review_content.Placements: Placements were very good. Almost 100% of students got placed in this course. Top recruiting companies visited our college for recruitment. The salary package was decent.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was excellent. Classrooms were well-maintained. Hostel was decent. The food served in the mess was great.
review_content.Faculty: Professors were educated. All teachers completed their degrees. The teaching quality was good. Teachers were very helpful and knowledgeable.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of poor faculty and facilities.

review_content.Placements: Placements in our college are average. I have never seen an MNC visiting our campus. However, they provide 100% placement, and it is true. But, the companies are poor. They provide an average salary of Rs. 8,000 per month. The highest salary offered is Rs. 12,000 per month. But, the main thing is that the jobs offered are not related to our field, i.e., computer science. Mostly, insurance companies and finance companies recruit students from our campus and offered roles in marketing.
review_content.Infrastructure: The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled, but the usage is limited to 20 Mb per day per device. The first-year building is very good, but the department buildings are too bad. Washrooms are more than 15 years old and not good. There is no vehicle available during medical emergencies. If any incident takes place, then the vehicle of any of the staff members is used. Books available in the library are too old. There are no books for regulation since 2013. Sports and games are average.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2015
reviews_list.review_title: I am slightly disappointed with the way they are managing the business school students.

review_content.Placements: I could say that the placement cell is below par. But, most of the students were placed in small-scale firms and companies. The lowest salary offered was Rs. 7,500 per month and the highest salary was Rs. 17,000 per month. Companies like Goodwill Commodities, Cafeteria, Indoshell, Sri Kannapiran Mills, LGP, Aqua Sub, and Citi Bank visited our college for recruitment. Most of the roles offered to the students were related to public relations officer, sales and marketing executive, and front office executives. There's no such thing like stipend or internship from our college. Our placement cell is not much efficient.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2018
reviews_list.review_title: Not very satisfied with the teaching medium first and foremost. Even though infrastructure is well.

review_content.Placements: The placements offered were not good, just local companies that provide very less salary. For seniors, the placements were good, but this year no good placements were offered. The companies which are asking for the sales executive and marketing executive only are coming that provides less salary and heavy work.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. There are good separate blocks for the separate departments in the college. The college canteen is bad and bad Wi-Fi. The labs depend on the department that you are in. The medical facilities are bad. The sports facilities are great even for the girls. The library is very well-maintained.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: My opinion about the college is that it is a good college with good and experienced faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Various national companies visit the college for on-campus placement of students from various engineering departments. Most of the civil engineering students get an average placement of 4 LPA-4.5 LPA. The highest placement offered is 7 LPA. Mostly the college prefers to get the toppers of college in good multinational companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has a very good infrastructure and good clean campus. For sports, various grounds and courts are available. In the main ground, the college has planted beautiful almond trees, which enhance the charm of the campus more. The college has various labs equipped with modern instruments machines and equipment.

overview_faqs.question: What is the semester-wise fees for BCom at Jigyasa University?
overview_faqs.answer: The semester-wise fee for BCom at Jigyasa University is INR 30,000. The total BCom fee at Jigyasa University for three years (six semesters) is INR 1.8 lakh. Candidates must note that this fee is sourced from the official website of the institute/sanctioning body. It is still subject to change and hence, is indicative. The other components included in the Jigyasa University fees are one-time fees, security deposit, hostel fee, mess fee, etc.

overview_faqs.question: What is the course fees for 3 years B.A course at Jigyasa University?
overview_faqs.answer: At Jigyasa University (formerly known as Himgiri Zee University), BA fee varies across the BA specialisations. The range of BA tuition fee at the university is INR 1.4 Lakh - and INR 2.1 Lakh. Candidates must note that this fee is sourced from the official website of the institute/sanctioning body. It is still subject to change and hence, is indicative. The other components included in the Jigyasa University fees are registration fees, security deposit, hostel fee, mess fee, etc.

overview_faqs.question: Is Jigyasa Univeristy a good option for pursuing BCom?
overview_faqs.answer: Jigyasa University, Dehradun offers BCom (Hons) with a total intake of 30 students. The university claims to have a well-designed curriculum for BCom. The curriculum comprises theory and practical application of concepts that prepare students to meet the challenges of the growing business world. The university also has a dedicated placement cell to assist students in finding suitable job opportunities. The maximum package record during the campus placements is INR 10 LPA across all the courses. Top companies including Bajaj, Wipro, ZEE Media, and others are known to have participated in the Jigyasa University placement drive. The university offers free Wi-Fi, hygienic classrooms and labs. There is a central library at the university. The hostel and mess facilities are also available the campus. The overall rating of Jigyasa University based on the student reviews on Shiksha.com is 4.1/5.

overview_faqs.question: What is the semester-wise fee for BPharma at Jigyasa University?
overview_faqs.answer: The semester-wise fee for BPharma at Jigyasa University is INR 55,000. The total BPharma fee at Jigyasa University for four years (eight semesters) is INR 4.4 lakh. review_summary.college_name: Jigyasa University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Computer Application - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great faculty, placements, and infrastructures.

content.Placements: In Jigyasa University, 90% of BCA students get placed with packages ranging from 3 to 6 LPA. Around 90% of students secure internships in top firms like Hero Wired and Pisoft Informatics Limited. The best roles are offered, ensuring strong career prospects.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostel offers great facilities, quality food, medical support, and sports options. The technical department includes 24x7 Wi-Fi, computer labs, more than 3 clean classrooms, and a vast library. It ensures a strong academic environment. The hostel has good freedom.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Computer Application - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: We have a very big campus and good placements.

content.Placements: In my batch, there were 18 students. I have to be honest about the placement system; it's not exceptional, but the placement cell is doing its best to provide good opportunities for students. I would say about 50% of my batch has secured placements or internships, while the rest are pursuing their paths.
content.Infrastructure: Regarding infrastructure, our university is impressive. It features a large campus with a swimming pool and a spacious football field. There are two parking areas and a beautiful agricultural section. The campus spans approximately 40 acres of land, and it's particularly stunning in the evening.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: If you want to become successful, then take admission in our college.

content.Placements: Our college has a good placement team which always places more students in good companies. The average package of our college is 4 lacs/annum. Top recruiting companies for our course that come to our college include Zee Media, Dainik Jagran, Amar Ujala, etc. 100% of students got internships at Zee Media.
content.Infrastructure: All equipment used in our field is available. The campus is 55 acres with Wi-Fi. The labs are fully furnished, and the classrooms and washrooms are clean. All faculty members are helpful. The open cafeteria and good food are available in the canteen and mess. Medical facilities are also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely the best college because of good placements and facilities.

content.Placements: Maximum placements were placed in my college with an average of 95%, and the good thing is the average package is 5-6L per annum. The highest package is 3 cr per annum, and the lowest is 3L per annum. 100% of students got internships in all types of colleges and schools to which they are capable.
content.Infrastructure: All rooms have Wi-Fi connections. There is a separate auditorium hall for all other courses . The library is available anytime for any student. The hostel is so affordable with lots of facilities like Wi-Fi 4 times, food, and 24*7 medical facilities, a cafeteria with healthy food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Jigyasa university.

content.Placements: I am a student at Jigyasa University of the 2022 batch in B.Tech computer science engineering; there is almost 50 to 80 percent placement rate, but the average package is around 3 to 5 lacs depending on the student in computer science; mostly web development or data science job roles are offered.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good in our university, as almost every single class has its own projectors and smart screens consisting of good quality tables and chairs. As for hostels, I am a day scholar, but I have visited hostels as well, and they are well maintained.

reviews.review_text: Regarding infrastructure, our university is impressive. It features a large campus with a swimming pool and a spacious football field. reviews.review_heading: If you want to become successful, then take admission in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely the best college because of good placements and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jigyasa university.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of college life is not up to mark.

reviews.review_heading: If you are looking to get your B.Tech done in between 4 LPA - 5 LPA, go for it.
reviews.review_text: There are 3 labs, out of which, 2 have the latest 12th gen in them. When it comes to the infrastructure of this course, it has changed since 2023. The curriculum has changed and now focuses more on developing ideas instead of just remembering which is good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides all students with good placements in reputed companies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is very good. The library and classrooms are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college, and I would recommend students to join this college.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good campus in Dehradun.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available in the university. Hygienic labs and classrooms are available. The university has a central library. Hostel facilities are above-average. The food is good, and the prices are very less compared to outside restaurants. Sports are conducted by the university, and they are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Hotel facilities are good with hygienic and tasty food being served.

reviews.review_heading: Placement cell is average for agriculture students in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and medical facilities are very good.

overview_faqs.answer: Sana Engineering College is a well-known institution for MBA/PGDM, B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, After 1th Diploma courses. These programs are delivered by highly experienced faculty. As per Shiksha verified reviews, Sana Engineering College has a rating of 2.9 on the basis of reviews by students. review_summary.college_name: Sana Engineering College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My College Review, Satisfied because of average faculty and working days of college .

content.Placements: There are nearly 85% of students placed in my course, with the highest package being 12 LPA, the lowest package at 7 LPA, and the average package ranging from 3-4 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Infosys, IBM, and Oracle. In the last batch, almost 40 students secured internships in Infosys and IBM as software engineers and data analysts.
content.Infrastructure: My course has a wide range of support, including the best faculty, well-equipped computer labs, and internet support. The infrastructure of the classrooms is average. I don't stay in my hostel, but I know about it. I went there and saw the average infrastructure and hygienic bathrooms.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of Sana Engineering College.

content.Placements: About 30% of students got placed in our course. The highest salary package offered was 5 LPA. Companies did not visit our college to recruit students. Our college had not provided internship opportunities for students.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provided good infrastructure and facilities. Our college departments were good and hygienic. All departments were separate. All labs had good equipment. Our classrooms were good and around 60-70 students were accommodated. Our library had all course-related books. Our college did not provide a hostel for boys. The hostel facility was available for girls only. Our college had a canteen. Our college provided sports, games, and medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The college is good in terms of education.

content.Placements: Maximum salary offered in civil engineering is about 30k per month. Placements are less in the college. Many students don’t get jobs in civil engineering but there is high score for CSE and EEE students. Most of the students get jobs.
content.Infrastructure: The quality and taste of food is good. Infrastructure of hostels and classrooms is so good. They are cleanly maintained. The only thing is that no borders are there for the college students. They can go from wherever they want. This is only the thing I do not like but everything else is good when it comes to infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely, I am dissatisfied because of facilities and faculty.

content.Placements: 90% of students were placed in my college. The highest package is one Lacs and the lowest is 50000 offered in my course. The top recruiting companies are Tata, Infosys and Microsoft etc. 10% of students got internship in top companies. No top roles are offered in my course.
content.Infrastructure: There are no good facilities at all. There is no Wi-Fi connection. In labs. there are insufficient equipment. There is no canteen at all. Students are suffering due to less facilities. There are no sports and games. Quality of food is very bad too.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This college is not good to study. I am dissatisfied because of faculty members.

content.Placements: In our college, placements are not good all the time. Students with minimum qualifying marks can get admission into this college. Students with over 6.5% in B.Tech have a chance to get a job. Companies that visit our college are Wipro, Infosys, etc. There are many job opportunities in CSE and ECE branches.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, hostel facilities are not good like rooms, washrooms, food, etc. In this college, the library is good because all facilities are available to learn. Labs are dirty, and I don't like to go to labs because of most of the dust. Sports are good in our college, and they support as much as possible.

admission_process.title: Nagarjuna College of Management Studies Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Nagarjuna College of Management Studies offers various courses at UG and PG level.Nagarjuna College of Management Studies admission processis a multi-step process. Candidates can take admission through entrance exam and merit-based admissions are done under management quota.
Step 1: NCMS Application form filling

Candidates seeking admission in the UG programmes have to visit the official college website and download application form of preferred course. They must fill it with all the personal and educational details.
Students applying for PG programs have to fill the Karnataka PGCET exam form and either of MAT/KMAT/CMAT/ATMA for MBA programme.
Step 2: Documents attached
Students have to physically attach the attested, relevant documents by the competent authority along with the application form. Admission committee verifies the documents and application form.
Step 3: Counselling
For students applying for UG programmes, the admission committee shall remain counselling centre and students are selected on merit-basis depending upon performance in last qualifying exam.

Candidates applying for PG programmes should register for KEA counselling and select Nagarjuna College of Management Studies and preferred course for admission. Students are selected based on performance in the entrance exam. Students are also given admission through the management quota.
Step 4: Fee Payment

At the time of admission, the selected students shall pay the Nagarjuna College of Management Studies course fee through bank challan/ on-line. Once, the admission is confirmed, admission committee receives the office copy of bank challan/ NEFT certificate for successful payment by the candidate.

Nagarjuna College of Management Studiesseat intake varies according to the course. The seats availability determines admission into different courses at Nagarjuna College of Management Studies. The college releases list of selected students after merit-based application in case of all UG programmes and some seats for PG programmes under management quota. Students scoring above the cut-off rank in PGCET for all PG programmes and MAT/KMAT/CMAT/ ATMA for MBA are included in the final merit-list along with students of management quota.

reviews_list.review_title: Jyothi Institute of Management and Research.

review_content.Placements: Placement crew got collaborated with average payable companies. In my batch, according to my memory, companies like Axis Bank, P&G, Tynor Orthotics, Revvlocity came for hiring, and the top package was 4.1 LPA at that time. But overall percent of placement was above 50, and nowadays they promised to give above 75 percent at least.
review_content.Infrastructure: Basically, the canteen areas were so messy, crowded, and filled with noise at any time, making it frustrating to reach the canteen even for buying food. The classrooms were so compact, and hostellers were allowed to share with 4 to 5 members in a single compact room, which was heartbreaking.

reviews_list.batch_info: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: The best college for MBA.

review_content.Placements: After completing this college's MBA programme, about 80% of the students land jobs. The average compensation package offered by the college was between 4 and 8 LPA. For our programme, ICICI Bank, IDBI Bank, Fincare, MRF, and other top hiring firms were involved. Sales manager, sales marketing, HR, and business development were the main roles that were open at the college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The institution provides outstanding facilities such as smart classrooms, a duplex auditorium, a waiting lounge, a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, an AI Lab, a library, and an innovation and research lab, the hostel amenities are tidy, cozy, and safe while offering quality meals. The management provides a medical emergency service available 24/7 for the students. Sports avenues encompass basketball courts, indoor sports, fitness centers, yoga studios, dance spaces, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, the best college for the MBA course.

review_content.Placements: About 77% of students are placed in my college. The highest package is 24 LPA, the lowest is around 7 LPA, and the average package is 15 LPA. The top recruiting firms are Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, etc. About 72% of students receive job offers. The top roles offered are investment banker, financial analyst, and more.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs, a library, a virtual classroom, and Wi-Fi are all great. I like the cuisine there, it is as good as what I cook at home, and it's excellent. The college is situated in the middle of the city. The boys' and girls' dorms are separate on campus. There are ways to get around. It features a café, library, and information center.

Established in 2016, Santhigiri Institute of Management is a private institute in Idukki, Kerala. The institute is approved by the AICTE. At the PG levels, the institute offers 1 course across 1 specialisation in Full Time mode. The popular Santhigiri Institute of Management program include MBA/PGDM. Santhigiri Institute of Management course is provided in stream including Business & Management Studies. The institute has a total seat intake of 90 students. reviews_list.batch_info: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Decent college with good facilities, but located in a remote area.

review_content.Placements: Campus placements are conducted every year mainly for final-year students and sometimes for third-year students as well. However, students must clear all subjects on time to be eligible. Those with backlogs usually cannot sit for placements. Overall, placement opportunities are decent, but students must be serious about academics.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has a decent campus environment, which helps in overall learning. The library and laboratories are well-equipped and useful for students. There is also a stationery store and a printing press on campus, where most employees are different-able, which is a really good initiative by the college. However, the college is located in a remote area, which makes travelling difficult.

reviews_list.batch_info: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: One of the bad remarks is college is situated in a remote location.

review_content.Placements: Campus placements happen every year in my college at the end of the third year or for fourth-year students. Campus placements if we have to get jobs in campus placements we have to complete all subjects on time.
review_content.Infrastructure: College campus is one of the main aspects of learning process. Santhigiri College provides greater campus experience with well-equipped library and lab. College has also a stationary store which is running by disabled persons. Also, college runs a press where most of the employees are disabled persons.

reviews_list.batch_info: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Best college for my career.

review_content.Placements: The placement activity in our college is so good, as all the students are getting good job opportunities. The top reputed companies have visited our college for placement, offering higher job positions. The average package we offer is 16 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostels are really good here. No sharing; 3 rooms for 1 person. The water quality is not that good in the hostels, and mess facilities are not very good either. The registration process is not very difficult since it's a residential program, and everyone is allotted a hostel. The registration for the hostel starts at the time of admission to the college.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with good facilities, but located in a remote area.
reviews.review_text: The college has a decent campus environment, which helps in overall learning. The library and laboratories are well-equipped and useful for students. There is also a stationery store and a printing press on campus, where most employees are different-able, which is a really good initiative by the college. However, the college is located in a remote area, which makes travelling difficult.

reviews.review_heading: One of the bad remarks is college is situated in a remote location.
reviews.review_text: College campus is one of the main aspects of learning process. Santhigiri College provides greater campus experience with well-equipped library and lab. College has also a stationary store which is running by disabled persons. Also, college runs a press where most of the employees are disabled persons.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for my career.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are really good here. No sharing; 3 rooms for 1 person. The water quality is not that good in the hostels, and mess facilities are not very good either. The registration process is not very difficult since it's a residential program, and everyone is allotted a hostel. The registration for the hostel starts at the time of admission to the college.

They also have to pass all exams with at least an 80% score or the equivalent CGPA, and they shouldn’t have any backlogs. Moreover, students must make sure that all fee payments are done according to the schedule mentioned in the offer letter. Finally, students are expected to follow the Sunstone Placement Policy Guidelines throughout the program.

The institute provides more than 20 advanced certifications to expand the horizons. Alongside this, the students undergo immersive internship projects in top companies for more than 8 months . Comparing the placement stats with other top-tier PVT colleges, the Wisdom School of Management Powered by Sunstone witnessed the participation of seven times more recruiters.

During the 2025 placements, the University hosted a panel of over 1,200 recruiters . More than 150 job profiles were offered to MBA students. The highest package offered during WSM Powered by Sunstone placements 2025 was INR 26 LPA , and the average package stood at INR 4.60 LPA.
